clauses.reason: Define the last incorporated parent tip so a batch synchronization advances it.

updates.rationale: The member's own diff is the honest unit of selection: the parent's diff is qualified by the parent's own ready, and checks still run on the complete tree. Reusing the verified synchronization record and the existing workspace-sync form keeps one ownership rule, one ratchet baseline and no new option; a member's natural upstream is its parent until the parent is delivered, then the delivery branch. A verified batch sync carries the parent's exact admitted tip, so it advances the held tip without another record.
scope: Member opening, synchronization, readiness and status
updates.statement: workspace-open given the branch of another registered member workspace as base records that branch as the member's parent and its exact tip as the immutable base; that record is the only source of the chain. The member's contribution and selection run from that base, excluding paths later merged from the parent by maintenance workspace-sync, whose default source for a stacked member is its parent while the parent branch exists and is not in the fetched delivery branch; it records a sync of kind parent and requires the new parent tip to descend from the last incorporated one. The last incorporated parent tip is the newest, by ancestry, of the base, each verified parent sync source and the parent's latest admitted tip in each verified batch sync source. ready and admission refuse while the open parent branch has moved past the last incorporated parent tip. The status next action names that synchronization or the admission order.

decisions.reason: workspace-sync --batch is the documented way to bring batch work into a member, and a batch that admitted the parent carries an exact admitted parent tip. Counting only parent syncs left that tip unrecorded, so ready, which judges ancestry, and admission, which judges the recorded tip, disagreed with no recovery except advancing the parent again. Reading the admitted tip from the verified batch source keeps admission exact without a new record, trailer or option. Recording an extra parent sync on unchanged was rejected because it would add machine-local state for a fact Git history already proves.

transaction.reason: Apply the approved held parent tip decision
